newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ANA eyes new links to US cities.
newsitem.headline: ANA eyes new links to US cities.

text.p: All Nippon Airways (ANA) is interested in establishing air links from Kansai, Osaka, to U.S. cities like Honolulu, Los Angeles and New York, managing director of sales and marketing Osamu Nagahata said on Friday.

"We don't have any specific points in the U.S. but we are very interested in new links with Kansai airport with the United States...Honolulu, Los Angeles and New York," he told reporters after a briefing in Singapore.
The U.S. and Japan are expected to resume their aviation talks on air passenger service rights and their 1952 aviation agreement after the U.S. Presidential elections in November.
Washington is expected to ask for more routes for U.S. carriers to Japan and beyond as well as to clarify rights under the existing pact.
Nagahata said ANA supported the Japanese government's proposal for equal opportunities in air rights.

"In the future, I think it's only fair that the United States has the right to fly to Japan to somewhere else but Japan should also have the right to fly from the United States to another country," he said.
He added that in terms of market value, the right to fly from Japan to Southeast Asia was greater than the right to fly from the U.S. to Europe or from the U.S. to South America.
